title: Environmental Impact Assessments for Construction Works Near National Parks or Nature Reserves
what_it_is: Environmental Impact Assessments for Construction Works Near National Parks or Nature Reserves

sections.label: Environmental impact assessment requirements
sections.summary: Significant projects require further environmental studies and mitigating measures, and EIA findings will be made public unless confidentiality is needed.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: If the potential environmental impact of a project is assessed to be significant, we will require the project developer to conduct further environmental studies to thoroughly assess the nature and magnitude of the impact, and to implement more extensive mitigating measures to address them.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As I have previously said in this House, our intention is to make publicly available the findings from such environmental impact assessments (EIAs), unless there are specific reasons, such as security considerations, that require us to maintain confidentiality.

sections.label: Publishing EIA findings
sections.summary: EIA reports have been gazetted in full, and Tengah's environmental baseline study findings were shared publicly and with nature groups.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: EIA reports have been gazetted in full to make very clear to interested parties, including the environmental groups, what the findings are and what the impact is.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For Tengah, the findings of the environmental baseline study were shared with the public through the media in October last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will also be engaging with nature groups to share with them the details of the environmental baseline study.
